title: Drive a VCF Operations action to a terminal state from PowerShell
prompt:
Our VCF Operations automation needs `Invoke-VcfOpsActionAndWait` in the `VcfOpsActionRunner` module to actually work. Right now `src/VcfOpsActionRunner/Public/Invoke-VcfOpsActionAndWait.ps1` is a signature and a `throw`.

Implement it against VCF Operations in VCF 9.0. `docs/contract.json` is the wire contract for the calls involved, derived from the VCF Operations OpenAPI document; `docs/official_sources.json` records where each fact in it came from. Both files are settled - read them, don't change them.

What the function has to do:

- Submit the action with the `performAction` operation: one parameter group per `-ResourceId`, with the `-Parameter` name/value inputs applied to every group.
- Take the task identifier out of the submission response and poll `getActionStatus` with it until the appliance reports a terminal state. A 200 from the submission means the task started, not that it finished. Any state that is not terminal means "still running" - keep polling.
- Wait `-PollIntervalSeconds` between polls. If `-TimeoutSeconds` elapses without a terminal state, raise a terminating error that names the timeout.
- A terminal state that means failure is a result, not an error: return it with `Succeeded` set to false.
- `-IncludeDetail` asks the appliance for per-object detail on each poll.
- Return a single object with `ActionId`, `TaskId`, `State`, `Succeeded`, `PollCount`, `Messages` (the status message strings) and `Status` (the status object as returned).

Constraints:

- `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Ops` is installed in the environment and is the only route to the appliance. No `Invoke-RestMethod`, no `HttpClient`, no hand-built URLs, and do not vendor the SDK into this repository.
- Optional fields the caller did not supply must not reach the wire at all - not as `null`, not as `""`, not as `[]`. The same goes for optional query parameters, which must be absent rather than sent at their default. `docs/contract.json` marks which fields are optional.
- Keep the existing parameter names, types and defaults.

`pwsh -NoProfile -File tests/Verify-Contract.ps1` must pass. It exercises the module against a loopback mock and inspects the requests that were actually sent. `tests/` is protected - do not edit it.

environment.network: Only 127.0.0.1 is required at verification time. No live VMware endpoint is contacted.

prerequisites.name: VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Ops
prerequisites.description: Generated VCF Operations PowerCLI client. Installed by the environment; the seed never vendors it.

verification.description: Starts the contract mock on an ephemeral loopback port, connects VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Ops to it, drives Invoke-VcfOpsActionAndWait through a minimal submission, a fully-populated submission, a terminal failure and a timeout, then asserts the exact request wire shape from the mock's request log: path, query string, headers, and the presence or absence of every optional field.
